habitica.description:
Habitica is a gamified productivity powerhouse that transforms your life into a grand adventure. By turning your chores into monsters to defeat and your goals into gold to earn, it makes self-improvement feel like a multiplayer RPG rather than a burden. Whether you are battling procrastination in a party with friends or collecting rare mounts for your avatar, Habitica leverages psychological gaming loops to turn real-world progress into the ultimate winning strategy.

Habitica is an open-source habit-building program that treats your life like a role-playing game. Level up as you succeed, lose HP as you fail, and earn Gold to buy weapons and armor.
